caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall clock with a long, rectangular case, featuring a glass front panel. The main body of the clock is reddish-brown with carved decorative elements at the top and bottom, and two gold-colored finials on either side of a central curved pediment. The clock face is circular, white in color, with black Roman numerals and black clock hands. The pendulum, visible through the glass front, is metallic gold and hangs vertically inside the case, with a blue pendulum rod. The clock is mounted on a curved, ornate base attached to the wall, and the overall composition is centered within a lightly outlined rectangular border on a beige background.
title: Wall Clock
